why: What keeps the widening affordable: three claims quoting three different sentences of one newsletter travel as three citations and ONE source block, because the block is emitted once per distinct context and a source item this size travels whole. If this ever reports three blocks, the grounding stage has quietly started paying for the same newsletter once per claim.
